caption: A white lamp is seen through a jar of yellow juice and looks yellow through the jar.

sa.check: A jar of yellow juice is present.
A white lamp is seen through it.
The lamp looks yellow through the jar.
Beside the jar the lamp looks white.

pc.expect: The lamp looks yellow only where the jar's light reaches and while it is on.
pc.fail: The lamp is yellow with the jar off; or stays white under the yellow light; or turns a different colour from the light.

pc.expect: The change happens at the same instant as the jar and is confined to where its light falls.
pc.fail: The lamp changes before the jar; or long after; or surfaces the light cannot reach change too.

pc.expect: The lamp is the same lamp, tinted, and shifted only by the jar's curve.
pc.fail: A different lamp appears; or it is mirrored; or it is enlarged far beyond the jar.

pc.expect: Nothing moves; only the light changes.
pc.fail: The lamp moves; or the jar moves by itself; or the lit area wanders.
A second jar appears; or the lamp vanishes; or the light becomes solid.

pc.expect: The lamp's shape and the surroundings stay the same.
pc.fail: The lamp changes shape; or the surroundings rearrange; or the jar changes shape.

note: The hand is the minimal trigger; the person is not judged.
